title: Ex-Chihuahua Prosecutor César Jáuregui Arrested on Federal Treason Charge Over CIA Participation in Drug-Lab Raid
detail: Former Chihuahua state prosecutor César Jáuregui was arrested on Oct 17 after a state judge denied pretrial detention on state charges; FGR agents then executed a federal warrant for treason (traición a la patria), reportedly over unauthorised CIA agent participation in an April 2026 operation against clandestine labs in Chihuahua. He was moved to the Almoloya de Juárez federal prison, with a federal hearing set for Oct 20. Sheinbaum discussed the case at her Oct 19 press conference.

media.caption: FGR detains César Jáuregui for treason
